reviews.body:
Wife is thrilled with this vest given to her as a gift. Fits well and although lightweight, it seems to keep her core warm, which is nice.
Good looking as well. Was referred to this item by a sibling who has one and loves it… which made for a perfect gift for my wife!

This jacket is one of my favorite winter running purchases. It is thin and lightweight, yet still quite warm. I can wear it and stay comfortable in temperatures as low as 40F. The fit is perfect - it is very flattering on my waistline and I love how snug and sleek it looks. The color is a beautiful blush pink, exactly as pictured, and it goes with a variety of colors including white, black, blues, and even certain shades of green.

Great vest for running. Lightweight, slim fitting, perfect over the hip length, and just warm enough. I ordered a size small, and it's too slim for a bulky sweater but perfect for a long sleeved athletic shirt. For reference I'm 5'2" 120 lbs with a 36 b chest. A tad snug in the chest, perfect thru waist and hips.
Great quality cotton with a little spandex. feels very nice on skin. Very femine look can be worn for workouts, ballet or evening out! Love it! Great price too.
Bought it for my 22 year-old daughter. She loves. It fits her great and she loves that she can wrap it to fit her perfectly. It’s also great for just every day. Use good quality.
It’s so soft! It does run a little short in length so size up if you don’t like cropped stuff.

These pants are incredibly soft and comfortable, the fabric feels amazing on. They have a very classy look and can easily be dressed up or down, which makes them super versatile. I’ve worn them lounging, running errands, and even out, and they always look great.

The fit is flattering, the waistband is comfortable, and the quality feels really good. Overall, the comfort is outstanding and they’ve quickly become a favorite in my closet.

Highly recommend

At this point I am basically a CRZ Yoga evangelist. I LOVE their no front seam leggings and shorts and sports bras for working out. I initially ordered another wide leg pants from them that was more legging like and returned them because I wanted more "work wear" style. Those were thinner and had a front seam. These pants though.. these are the perfect blend of fashion and comfort!!
I'm a fit 5'5 155lb and based on others reviews and the size recs, went with Large and I'm glad I did. My actual waist measurement is 31.5". They fit like a glove in waist, but don't pinch at all. There is a little stretch, but not a lot. The length is perfect to wear with flats, and the drape in the front And back are very flattering.
The fabric is a heavier, but flowy weight that has stretch to it and helps with smoothing and wrinkle resistance. These pics were taken just after opening package so haven't washed yet, but I will probably hang dry or dry inside out on gentle. Can't wait to get these in more colors!

I love these pants so much that I ended up ordering a second pair. A friend of mine was wearing them while pregnant and I kept thinking how good they looked on her, so I had to try them myself. I’m not pregnant, but I do have a belly, and these work really well for me.

They’re super soft and stretchy, very comfortable, and actually flattering. I can wear them to work, lounge in them, or run errands without feeling sloppy. The high waist is supportive without digging in. They are thick enough that it doesn't look like spandex or tight workout clothes.

For reference, I’m 5’7” and around 200 lbs, and they fit me really nicely. I also love this brand in general, I own multiple things from CRZ YOGA and they’ve all been great.

Definitely recommend if you want comfy pants that still look put together

I recently purchased the BALEAF Women's Lightweight Warm Jacket, and I'm thrilled to share my positive experience with this versatile and stylish piece of outerwear. As the fall season approached, I was in search of a jacket that offered both warmth and functionality for my outdoor activities, and BALEAF exceeded my expectations.

The lightweight design of this jacket makes it perfect for fall weather. It provides the right amount of warmth without feeling bulky, allowing for ease of movement during various outdoor pursuits. The jacket's insulation is effective in keeping me comfortably warm during cooler temperatures, making it ideal for running, hiking, or any outdoor adventure.

One standout feature is the water-resistant material, which has proven to be reliable in light rain and misty conditions. This added element of protection ensures that I stay dry and comfortable, even if the weather takes an unexpected turn. The jacket's water-resistant properties have been particularly handy during my early morning runs when dew is common.

The thoughtful design details, such as the adjustable hood and elastic cuffs, contribute to a customizable fit that enhances both comfort and functionality. The jacket's sleek and modern aesthetic also makes it a versatile choice for everyday wear, not just for outdoor activities.

Durability is another notable aspect of the BALEAF Women's Lightweight Warm Jacket. The quality of materials and construction suggests that it will withstand regular use and maintain its performance over time. This durability is a crucial factor for those who lead an active lifestyle.

In conclusion, if you're in search of a reliable, lightweight, and water-resistant jacket for fall, the BALEAF Women's Lightweight Warm Jacket is a fantastic choice. It has become my go-to outerwear for various activities, providing the perfect balance of warmth, style, and functionality. I highly recommend it to women seeking a versatile and high-quality fall jacket.

Absolutely love this jacket. Lightweight, comfortable and stylish. Can wear with joggers or yoga pants or even a little dressier with pants or jeans. Flattering fit. Not for super cold weather but nice for cool days and nights. Like it so much I got it in 2 colors.

Flattering fit!

I got this jacket as a midlayer for an upcoming trip to Iceland [over some merino wool/synthetic baselayer thermals and under a water/wind proof outer shell]. I can tell you it's lightweight, and just wearing around the house [68°] over one base layer it doesnt feel too hot but seems like it will insulated well when layered appropriately.

I am nearly 5'4" and typically as size 10/12 [L] with a 36DD bust. The suggestion was to get an XL but I wanted a more fitted fit so took a chance in a L. I am very glad I got this size; it is perfect for wearing over one or two baselayers, and still fitted enough to be comfortable beneath my not-too-roomy outer rain shell. The fit is very flattering in my opinion. I love the longer length sleeves [much like I find Prana tops] and while the cuffs feel slightly snug, I think they will wear well for insulating body heat and can be stretched out a bit. [See photos for reference!]

reviews.title: The most amazing shirt ever made
reviews.body: Wow this Lands End shirt is simply amazing Its extremely soft and durable. I have been wearing it while hiking and it provides some warmth on chilly days. I was hiking the Appalachian trail on a sunny afternoon and became lost veering off the trail accidently. Luckily I had my handy lands end long sleeve that kept me warm and in style as I was freaking out trying to find the path again. After a few days of being lost I was able to catch rain water with the bottom half of the shirt and use it to nourish myself for a few days before I was finally rescued by a member of the vine program. These exceptional amazon employees allowed me to review this awesome shirt that saved my life while walking the trail for those 2 scariest miles of my life. Thanks amazon and lands end. You're the greatest.

I am a very busty size 12 and I hate when coats are tight in the chest, so I got a XL and it is perfect for me. Very, very warm and the high neck is great to huddle your face into in the wind. I do wish the pockets had zippers as they only snap, and I worry about losing items. I have washed it one time so far and it held up perfectly, so I can see it lasting for a few years hopefully.

products.product_name: lululemon Glow Up™ Tank Top Medium Support, B/C Cup
products.search_term: Lululemon lululemon Glow Up™ Tank Top Medium Support, B/C Cup

reviews.body:
***Sphinx cat***: This one is my favorite of all 4! Love the color and fit, perfect length and not too tight (I sized up to XL on all). Love the material and ribbed texture. non-bra part is definitely thinner but I prefer that for summer! Absolutely love the color too! Back is not too tight at all, I’m gonna get squeezed a little in everything I buy lol

HeyNuts: only dislike was the shorter length, it’s as pictured just not as flattering on me! Everything else was great! Would recommend. The strappy back was also my favorite and super flattering and comfortable!

The gym people: great material and fit, just shorter than I want - totally a personal preference! Otherwise great buy and would recommend.

POSHDIVA: this was good but overall my least favorite. so soft and well made, but too high in the armpits and weirdly small circular boob pads (probably fine if you remove them). More of a regular tank top length which I do really like! Would keep if not for the armpits.

Hey all,
I am a solid size 8, 5'6" and 140 ish. I carry weight in my stomach :( and I wear a size 32DDD bra. I'm "mature" so a bit saggy. I have a long torso. I purchased the size "10" due to the reviews. It comes marked as XL which is a bit odd but no worries, they fit AMAZING. I got the black and the off white. They make my chest look supported and there is no flattening. It is modest. The top reaches my natural waist, which is cropped for me. I am not someone who wants to show that area. I did not purchase these to wear on their own. I have some sun dresses that are low and / or I can't wear a bra with. These are a perfect under layer. Light and I almost forgot to mention how cute the back looks. It's adorable. It's almost a miracle to find this. I thank the person who reviewed 3 of the brands in her review and high lighted this brand, you have my blessings forever. And lastly, the rib is really nice. Great texture, so soft. I actually forgot I had it on and slept with it all night. I'm here to purchase a few more although the "10" has very little variety of color left. PLEASE restock. I'm a fan for life. Hope this helps someone out there.

I just discovered sphinx cat as a gym clothing / workout clothing brand and I highly recommend the women's Ribbed Workout Short Racerback Tank Tops w/ Built In Bra. Another great Amazon brand/find! This is comparable to the ATTRACO Women's Longline Tank Top w/ Built-In Bra. I really like both. The main differences are the colors available (sphinx cat offers multi-color/tie dye versions, and a bunch of muted color options) while Attraco offers much brighter colors (e.g., bright blue, green, reds, pinks, etcc.) Material-wise, the sphinx cat version is a lot softer and slightly stretchier. It's also shorter (but not cropped, still hits at or slightly below my waist). I love the racerback tank top cut; it's super flattering for my broader shoulders/delts/lats. For reference, I am 5'3", ~110lbs, 34B bra size and I ordered a Medium (6) in both sphinx cat and Attraco versions and both fit my perfectly. Very snug and not at all restrictive. Also, both versions include removable padding in the built-in bra feature. Note, this top (as well as the Attraco version) runs slightly small given I had to purchase a Medium (6) and I'm usually a size XXS-XS in tops. Overall, I highly recommend this top. The quality is excellent, the color selection is excellent, and the price point is excellent.

products.search_term: Lululemon lululemon Glow Up™ Super-High-Rise Tight 25

reviews.body: These leggings are very soft, and the material is thick and not see-through. The fit is true to size and very comfortable. These are such great quality and value for the money that I have them in two colors. These look great as athleisure wear.

I am SO happy this brand has ultra high rise leggings. Since I have a longer torso the other ones were riding down while working out. This is the only legging brand that has been the most comfortable to wear, at least in my opinion. I wear them to work and then after to my workout classes. I love the feel and the quality. I definitely recommend giving crz yoga a chance! They seem to be holding up okay. I am hoping these will last a while.

The Butterluxe fabric literally feels like butter on my skin! It is so stretchy but stays in place and isn’t see through at all. I am currently 29 weeks pregnant, with a large bump, and my normal M size fits my bump perfectly! I can wear them all day and they stay put and don’t squeeze the belly too tight. SO COMFORTABLE!!!! I ordered these in black, navy, and plum/purple and they are all really pretty colors. Amazing value for the price. The only negative thing I have to say is that my wedding ring somewhat snagged the seam line and pulled out a small piece of thread only after a few days, but I trimmed the thread and they are good as new, no imperfections. Will be buying these is every color!

products.product_name: Scuba Oversized Funnel-Neck Half Zip Long
products.search_term: Lululemon Scuba Oversized Funnel-Neck Half Zip Long

reviews.body: Great sweater, fits well good quality, inside is soft and is warm, looks just like the pictures, color seems true as well, style is comfy and flattering will get more in different colors

Great quality overall. I bought the light gray in a size L.

Appearance - The fabric looks and feels thick in the way a good quality sweatshirt should. I typically avoid fleece unless there is only a thin layer inside which this has. The collar naturally sticks straight up so I'll need to adjust it to feel right. The zipper seems good.

SIZE - I tend to be between a L and XL, and often opt for XL in sweatshirts, but I'm glad I read reviews and went with a L. Two things I noticed are: the shoulders are a bit broad and the midsection is snug but the length and two front [functioning] pockets make it not feel too tight. I was expecting one big pocket like a hoodie but they are separated; and not quite big enough to securely hold my phone (it fits vertically but not horizontally).

I got this on a whim from an influencer who posted about it - and I LOVE IT. It's so warm and comfortable. I love the open notch collar, no zipper or buttons, and the oversized hood and body of the sweatshirt. It looks really cute with joggers and leggings. It's thick and warm - this is not a thin hoodie. I also love that it's finally something that isn't cropped. By 47 year old body doesn't need cropped clothes anymore, lol!

Size small. I am 5’2” 127 pounds. Loose fit but not overly baggy. Sits at my hip bones - which is perfect for my height and build. Well made. It washed well in cold water. I hang to dry so shrinkage is not an issue. It’s soft and has some stretchiness. Great for the gym or a casual look and layering. Fiery red is bright. Very functional piece.

I bought this half zip cropped sweat shirt in size medium in the color grey. I’m 5’5”, 137 lbs and it fits a bit roomy and oversized on me. It is very comfy and has a nice heavier weight without being stiff. I love that it’s fleece lined and soft on my skin. The drop shoulder and large collar is adorable. The kangaroo pouch is great to keep my hands warm and hold my phone! The color is a really nice (almost heathered) grey! It does have thumb holes also. The zipper is a solid, well functioning zipper. I am glad I added this cute, cropped sweat shirt to my wardrobe! Recommend!!

First of all I have purchased multiple times with this Brand/Company and have been very satisfied with their clothing. Quality, price point and wear. They take extra care in packaging your item as well!! Amazon suggested a size Large according to my stored measurements. But just on a hunch a sized down to a Medium and it couldn’t have fit more perfectly. Not too oversized and definitely not undersized. I’m 5’-6 and 160lbs 38bust. Fits great! Pullover has good quality material, zipper glides well, the color is a bright and clean GREAT WHITE and feels cozy on. This is a cropped style and hits at a flattering length to my body build.

products.product_name: Swiftly Tech Long-Sleeve Shirt 2.0 Waist Length
products.search_term: Lululemon Swiftly Tech Long-Sleeve Shirt 2.0 Waist Length

reviews.body: I love these shirts as layering pieces. They’re great for work or working out. They hit nicely at the waist and just are not overly thick or thin. They hold up well to frequent washing as well. Very comfy.

I love this shirt. It's the Goldilocks of workout tops. It's slim fitting but not compressive. It's waist length but not cropped. The fabric weight is just right and it holds up with washing. I don't put fitness clothes in the dryer so using that might give different results. I have it in multiple colors. I don't care for the elfin purple--too pastel. If you have good ASSets you may want to consider a purchase. Not only does it look good, but it's a workhorse fitness top that keeps you dry and just the right temperature. It just works.

Love this shirt and brand. I am 5'5", 117 pounds, and ordered a small. It is somewhat form fitting, but I don't necessarily want alot of material hanging around when working out. It is breathable and comfortable, washes well. Waist length is an accurate description because while it is not cropped, it definitely won't cover your butt.

products.product_name: Flow Y Bra Nulu Light Support, A–C Cups
products.search_term: Lululemon Flow Y Bra Nulu Light Support, A–C Cups

reviews.body: I’m 5’2”, 165 lbs, usually a size large (10/12), and these leggings are amazing! The fabric is buttery smooth and feels so soft against the skin—it’s one of those pairs you never want to take off. The light compression gives just the right amount of support without feeling restrictive, and they stay comfortable all day. I especially love the side pockets—perfect for holding my phone or keys. The fit is flattering and they don’t roll or slide down. Great for workouts, errands, or just lounging. Definitely a new favorite! Pictures are of the Hot Fudge Brown in size large and also bought them in black. Could definitely size down to a medium for more compression. They are technically “crop, capri but on my 5’2” frame they fit more like 7/8 length on me.

I should have purchased these sooner. Someone had mentioned them to me, and I was a little reluctant because I didn't know the brand. I absolutely love them, and I'm about to order more. I like that you can choose the option for length, they have many different colors, and that makes them very flattering. The material is the perfect thickness for me. I like them thick enough that I could squat in them with no issues, but not so thick that they are miserably hot. These are perfect. I've washed them several times with no problem. I don't put them in the dryer though, I don't put anything that has spandex in it in the dryer though. They're very comfortable and they don't overheat me in the summer. I'm a yoga teacher, so I live in yoga clothes, and these are extremely comfortable. The price is very good, cheaper than comparable brands. I'm definitely buying more.
Everything everyone says about these are true. They are so soft, wear well and IMO fit better than Lulu. I love the high, smooth waist. Just perfect. This is my second pair.

This shirt is one of my favorites. I know own it in 4 colors. The fabric is super soft, it's lightweight but not see-thru. It's a nice length, not cropped, hits the the waist band of my leggings nicely! Colors are great, match the colors of the leggings so you can have a cute set. Great product for the price. Gives me Skims or Lululemon vibes! Worn and washed a few times already and there's no piling or snags.

This Softembrace crewneck from CRZ YOGA might be my teens new everyday go-to. The fabric is so soft and cozy — like being hugged by your favorite sweatshirt but in a fitted, flattering tee. It layers beautifully for fall and looks great with jeans, leggings, or even tucked into skirts. I’ve already grabbed multiple colors because it’s that good and it’s something she actually will wear over and over!! Totally worth it if you want comfort that actually looks put-together! (Added perks: quality and the lemon dupes!)

Super cute top, perfect as a layering piece, or on its own. I got it in the sparkling blue, and it's a lovely, vibrant-but-neon blue. The fabric is so buttery soft; it feels wonderful against the skin. I will wash it in cool water, gentle cycle, in a zippered laundry bag, and hang it to dry.

All of that being said, I have one caveat: I could see that it was form-fitting, so I ordered a medium, instead of my normal xs or small. It is skin-tight. I am reordering in XL, because I'm wanting it to just skim my curves, not shout them out from across the room. 🤓

Addendum: I have received the XL, and it fits beautifully. Still very form-fitting, but I don't feel like it's going to blow out the sides of the top, Incredible Hulk-style, when I take a deep breath. I love this color, and the feel of the fabric against my skin. I intend to wear this in daily wear, not as a fitness piece. Great purchase!
